# `/query-password-info` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /query-password-info/v1

`queryPasswordInfoV1` — Query password info

This API is used to query password related information.

- Scopes: idn:password-info:read
- Body (application/json): passwordinfoquerydto
- Returns 200: passwordinfo
